otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: Advertises the supported UCIe spec version (1.1) and capability set.
Standard Package vs Advanced Package; fixed by the silicon bump-out.
Advertised maximum lane rate (4..32 GT/s); the device must support all lower rates.
Lanes per module (16 or 64) and supported module counts (1/2/4).
PCIe / CXL.io / CXL.cache / CXL.mem / Streaming support bits.
Number of spare lanes (Advanced) or width-degradation capability (Standard).

notes: UCIe does not define OTP/fuse content as a protocol concept. The interoperability-relevant facts (package class, maximum data rate, module width/count, supported protocols, Flit format, spare-lane capability) are hardware-determined and advertised through sideband-accessible capability registers used during discovery and parameter negotiation; an implementation may back some of these with fuses, but the spec only requires they be discoverable.
